evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen was 4.6 ppm early in growth.
Exhaust oxygen rose persistently to 24.3 ppm during growth despite unchanged setpoints.
Exhaust oxygen reached 26.0 ppm, indicating an atmosphere departure from the earlier stable baseline.
Temperature of 750.1 °C and argon flow of 99.9 sccm track their 750 °C and 100 sccm setpoints.
The pressure gauge is not installed; pressure remains unavailable, preventing verification of the required growth atmosphere.

args.missing_evidence: A verified tube-pressure measurement and checks of exhaust flow, seal integrity, and O2 sensor accuracy are needed to distinguish the cause of rising oxygen; sample characterization is not yet available.
